hints.title: Left and Right Equilibrium
hints.text: A middle index requires that the sum of elements strictly to the left equals the sum of elements strictly to the right.

hints.title: Total Sum Derivation
hints.text: Compute the total sum of the array beforehand. As you iterate, the right sum is total_sum - left_sum - nums[i].

hints.title: Single Pass Scan
hints.text: Traverse from index 0 to n - 1, checking if left_sum == total_sum - left_sum - nums[i]. Return the first matching index.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Initial sum calculation followed by a single linear pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing left and right subarray sums for each index takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running sum accumulation evaluates balance in constant time per index.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should find the leftmost equilibrium index in O(N) time with O(1) space.
